page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s6-c1m1.small is an entry-level virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.s6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The instance is configured with 1 virtual CPU and 1.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:1 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Virtualization is managed via the KVM hypervisor.

A key architectural characteristic of this instance is its shared CPU allocation model. Because the single vCPU is shared among multiple tenants, compute performance may vary depending on host load. Additionally, the instance features no local storage and has a baseline network bandwidth of 0 Gbps, meaning all storage and external networking must be provisioned via attached cloud resources. There are also no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.s6-c1m1.small is positioned as a highly economical option for lightweight workloads. The minimal resource footprint and shared CPU model make it suitable for low-traffic web servers, development environments, microservices, and basic utility tasks that do not require sustained high CPU utilization or dedicated hardware resources.
